defaults.reason: This feature is not qualified for this provider and deployment.

access-surface: Derived from live provider access evidence.
dependency-audit: OSV unavailability is reported as incomplete, never clean.
exposure.scan: Detection, identity, storage and the bounded job exist and are tested; no route exposes them yet and no live-provider qualification has been run, so nothing here is usable.
file.batch: Qualified single-commit batch: one tree carrying several paths, committed against the observed head, with a non-fast-forward ref move refused.
file.rename: Implemented, but not exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness.
folder.move: Implemented, but not exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness.
global-search: GitHub code search respects connection access and server-enforced invitation repository scopes.
governance: Policy lifecycle is available when Neon is healthy.
issues.read: Qualified issue list and detail reads, including absent-resource discrimination.
issues.write: Implemented, but not exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness.
lfs: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: a synthetic object is uploaded to the LFS store and the provider withholds the upload action when asked again, without committing a pointer.
live-events: Implemented, but not exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness.
native-push: Qualified Git Data object upload: the identity the provider returns is the git object hash of the bytes sent, and the object reads back unchanged. The hosted size ceiling is a deployment bound, not a capability limit.
notifications: GitHub notifications respect invitation repository scopes and supported connection types.
pulls.read: Qualified pull-request list and detail reads, including absent-resource discrimination.
pulls.write: Implemented, but not exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness.
recovery: Snapshot compare and restore preview are supported.
releases.read: Qualified release list and detail reads, including absent-resource discrimination.
releases.write: Implemented, but not exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness.
repository.create: Personal repository creation with identity checks and provider readback; existing invitation scopes still apply.
repository.delete: Repository deletion with exact confirmation, fresh step-up and provider administrator permission.
search: Implemented, but not exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness.
stars.read: Implemented, but not exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness.
stars.write: Implemented, but not exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness.
tree.read: Qualified recursive tree listing bound to the file it names.
upload-security: Built-in bounded signature gate is active; YARA is not implied.
workflows.read: Qualified workflow-run list and detail reads, including absent-resource discrimination.
workflows.rerun: Implemented, but not exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness.
